payload.summary: Native Git Trace2 discovery now initializes worktrees outside configured roots on minor commands without profiles or Git lifecycle hooks. Tests cover status/diff/branch/ls-files/rev-parse/config and failed log, raw executable invocation, credential metadata exclusion, existing trace-target preservation and background consumption. The full 50-case suite and browser smoke pass locally; preparing cross-platform CI and machine upgrade.
payload.next: Validate organization CI and the installed raw-Git bootstrap, then publish v0.3.0.
